note: Ventura County's linear RV camping: back-in stalls along the ocean-side shoulder of the old coast highway (Rincon Parkway) between Faria and Hobson beaches, about 8 miles north of Ventura, with a boulder revetment and the beach below and US-101 and the railroad inland. Self-contained RVs only (no tents); portable toilets at intervals. --Claude
summary: County page (browser) + 2026 fee schedule read: $47 off-season / $51 peak, $10 online booking fee, +$17 extra vehicle (one allowed), $3/dog, 6 people; 127 self-contained stalls, no hookups/water/showers/dump, portable toilets; Itinio, 180 days at noon, 7-night peak limit; year-round. Waterfront bayfront -> bayview recommended (revetment); phone empty -> (805) 654-3951.
flags: WATERFRONT: stored 'bayfront' -> recommend 'bayview' (default down after every source). The stalls are on the parkway's ocean-side shoulder with nothing but a boulder revetment between them and the beach (county photos rincon-8224 and rincon-parkway-image1; Esri at 34.32992,-119.39953: stall to wet sand ~45-50 m), so the sightline to the open Pacific is unbroken. But 3DEP puts the stall at 5.5 m and the beach at the foot of the revetment at 2.0 m ~20 m away: a ~3.5 m climb down over large rip-rap boulders, which fails the kayak test (a 2-3.7 m bank at ~30 deg is a view; boulders are harder still). If AWH reads the revetment as an easy walk to the shore, 'coastal walk' is the alternative (nothing but the beach between; US-101 and the railroad are inland, not between). CONSISTENCY: Faria Beach 11753 (same revetment, next door) was kept 'bayfront' on 2026-11-26 - whichever way this is ruled, the two should match. Replacement evidence text: 'County photos + Esri + 3DEP 2026-11-27: back-in stalls on the ocean-side shoulder of Rincon Parkway, a boulder revetment then open beach to the Pacific (~45-50 m to wet sand); stall 5.5 m, beach 2.0 m - ~3.5 m rip-rap climb-down, open ocean view, not walk-across.'
